method.surface_sampling: Uniform triangle area with sqrt-barycentric sampling; global object allocation weighted by area
method.nearest: Unsigned point-to-triangle distance: mathutils BVHTree.FromObject (epsilon 0) neighborhood search, then float64 plane/segment closest-point refinement against original triangle vertices
method.boundary_sampling: Topological edges incident to one original polygon, sampled uniformly by total edge length; split UV/normal seams can be included
method.key_extremities: Per mesh: support vertices for 26 directions plus min/max coordinate vertices in each cell of 8x8 XY/YZ/XZ grids; duplicate positions removed
method.normalization: Independently for each asset: if raw world Z height < 3, uniform scale 100 then translate Z +63.785398; otherwise identity
method.percentile: NumPy linear percentile; surface statistics do not include deliberately biased boundary/extremity probes

bounds_difference.convention: candidate minus source; axis order X,Y,Z

limitations: The maximum is the largest measured sample/probe error, not an exhaustive or certified Hausdorff distance.
Area-weighted metrics can underrepresent small but important architectural features; boundary and local extremity probes reduce, but cannot eliminate, this risk.
Unsigned nearest distances do not prove matching topology, semantic correspondence, watertightness, material appearance or texture/normal fidelity.
All positive-area triangles are included, including internal/occluded faces, disconnected fragments and overlapping surfaces; vertices without area are represented only if selected as extremities.
Boundaries are topological, not inferred architectural creases or image silhouettes; unwelded seams may inflate their number.

Imported vertex coordinates have Blender float precision; float64 refinement measures those imported triangles. Tiny self residuals do not imply physical/survey precision or a certified global nearest bound.

Float64 refinement examines BVH nearest-range hits within raw nearest distance plus 0.1% of source diagonal. This empirically repairs slender-triangle precision errors; it is not a proof that the float BVH supplied every globally relevant face. Raw float distance aggregates are retained for every category and self-check.
No registration, best-fit alignment or geometry simplification is performed. Alignment and scale errors remain in the distances.

provenance.source_and_candidate_paths: Basenames only; SHA-256 identifies the measured artifacts

reporting_precision_note: Float64 refinement measures imported float32 triangle surfaces. Tiny self residuals demonstrate numerical self-consistency; they do not imply physical/survey accuracy or certified nearest bounds.
